The '''Moff High Council meeting chambers''' was a conference room in the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|New Imperial Palace]] where members of the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Moff Council]] held their meetings by [[137 ABY]].

It was in this location that [[Darth Maladi]], via holographic transmission, ordered the Moff Council to cancel the search for [[Cade Skywalker]]. Following [[High Moff]]'s [[Morlish Veed]]'s rise to the rank of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Regent/Legends|Regent]], Veed held a Council meeting in which he informed the Moffs of [[Operation: Thunderstroke]], a plan to capture [[Roan Fel]], and that he had been informed about the existence of a spy among Imperial ranks.
